verdict.what_is_wrong: PID 24874 (`python3`) shows a later burst of prolonged runnable-CPU waits while the four-CPU host is mostly idle, so there is a real process-level scheduling anomaly. However, the apparent ~0.5-core quota signature came from aggregating all `python3` processes, not PID 24874: its exact-PID runtime is only 21.6 ms over the measured 10 seconds, and no quota/throttling data or same-PID healthy baseline exists. A CPU cap is therefore not confirmed; the trace supports unexplained CPU starvation, not a defensible specific root mechanism.
